bio: Tech lead and mobile architect with a full-stack background and {years} years of experience building products end to end. I design and evolve the mobile platform Reserhub uses to ship some 20 ticketing apps for bus lines across Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, Peru and the United States: a Turborepo and Expo monorepo, a hybrid architecture that embeds the web checkout funnel, and a delivery process built on OTA updates, feature flags and staged rollouts. I lead a squad of five engineers and move between architecture decisions and production code across mobile, backend and web, with AI-assisted development behind quality gates. Before mobile I worked on IoT, SMD electronics and embedded firmware, which gives me a full view of the product, from device to cloud.
quote: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
skillsLead: These are some of the languages, frameworks and libraries I use in my projects:
toolsLead: These are the tools I work with today, including the AI tools I use every day to speed up design, development and code review:

platform.title: Mobile platform architecture
platform.description: I designed the Turborepo and Expo monorepo that serves 11 branded apps from shared packages for UI, services, SDKs and per-tenant configuration, documented in design docs that weigh alternatives such as Nx and Module Federation. Along the way I retired legacy stacks and consolidated the apps into a single modern, unified codebase.

commerce.title: E-commerce in production
commerce.description: I moved the enterprise apps’ checkout funnel to a hybrid architecture validated with an A/B test. Critical integrations: payments with 3-D Secure (Adyen, Mercado Pago, OpenPay, PayPal, Yuno), Riskified fraud prevention, analytics, push, per-brand deep links and magic-link authentication.

delivery.title: Delivery and quality
delivery.description: A standardized EAS Build and Submit pipeline, OTA updates, feature flags and progressive store rollouts, with Sentry and Maestro end-to-end tests. Monorepo test coverage went from 72% to 90% in five weeks.

leadership.title: Technical leadership
leadership.description: I lead a squad of five engineers through weekly 1:1s, architecture and code reviews, ADRs and retrospectives. I wrote the mobile team’s career ladder, from junior to Staff+, and take part in hiring.

ai.title: AI-assisted engineering
ai.description: I made a Compound Engineering loop, with OpenSpec specs and gates before every PR, mandatory across the mobile repos: simplification, verification by an isolated agent and code review. Scheduled agents raise coverage and review PRs.

fullstack.title: Full stack, device to cloud
fullstack.description: Beyond mobile, I build backend and web: I shipped the apps’ remote configuration admin to production, with an MCP server for agents, and earlier built microservices in Node.js and Python, an Angular CMS and a multi-tenant Rails platform, with Docker and deployments on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Render, Heroku and Vercel, among others.

reserhub.summary: I lead the mobile platform squad for the B2B vertical: the architecture, shared code and delivery process Reserhub uses to ship the ticketing apps of some 20 bus lines.
highlights: Designed and led the consolidation of the apps into a Turborepo and Expo monorepo: 11 branded apps, shared packages and per-tenant configuration.

Moved the enterprise apps’ checkout funnel to a hybrid architecture — a native shell embedding the web funnel, with native bridges for session, payments and deep links — validated with an A/B test and rolled out brand by brand.
Leading the migration of the Reservamos B2C app to the new platform with screen and analytics parity; split another branded app into its own repository, upgraded to Expo 58 and React 19.
Retired legacy stacks and concentrated development in a single unified, modern codebase on Expo and React Native.
Built and shipped the apps’ remote configuration admin, with an MCP server so AI agents can read and publish configurations.
Standardized the EAS pipeline and raised monorepo test coverage from 72% to 90%, with all 11 tenants at 100% line coverage.
Made an AI-assisted development loop (Compound Engineering + OpenSpec) with quality gates mandatory across the mobile app repositories.
Coordinate five engineers through weekly 1:1s, design and code reviews, ADRs, seven-week planning cycles and a full-platform learning program.

reservamos.summary: Led mobile development for the B2C vertical and the apps for enterprise bus lines, with a team of up to six engineers.
highlights: Maintained and evolved the Reservamos app on Expo and React Native, with the native Adyen and Riskified integrations wrapped in internal native libraries with React Native bridges, and brought it into the unified codebase for enterprise clients as one more brand.
Automated builds and store publishing with EAS and scripts shared across apps, adopted OTA updates and kept the Expo SDK current on the way to the React Native New Architecture.
Co-built Bus Tracker, a multi-tenant fleet tracking platform with a Rails backend, web dashboard and driver app.
Built the Vanda and Roll&Bits passenger and driver apps with Flutter.
Wrote the mobile team’s career ladder and interviewed candidates for the team.

chib.summary: Built new iOS and Android apps in Flutter for CHIB MX and CHIB USA for instant remittance transfers; developed and maintained the landing page and CMS admin in Angular 11; built microservices on Node.js/Express and Python/Flask; configured the Kong API Gateway; deployed the microservices to AWS with Jenkins and Docker; maintained a WhatsApp bot on Twilio; and handled app releases to Google Play and the App Store.

bussi.summary: Developed and maintained the BUSSI and BUSSI Driver apps, cross-platform applications built with Flutter. Worked with Dart, Swift, Java and Kotlin; GraphQL, Redux, Fastlane, Firebase and WebSockets; and released the apps to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

cantec.summary: Built cross-platform mobile apps with Xamarin Forms and React Native, supported the FamilyCard, MediChat and Multidoctores apps, designed UI/UX and programmed in .NET, JS, Java and Objective-C for iOS, Android and UWP. Released the apps to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, and managed Microsoft Azure for app operations.

skyalert.summary: Developed hardware and software using technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), cloud infrastructure and data analytics, along with seismic-study tools applied to the SkyAlert Network and to the evolution of the EPICENTER early-warning devices. I also led device supply efforts for commercial and corporate customers, building tools to make production and manufacturing resource planning more efficient.

sms.summary: Repaired HP and Asus laptop and all-in-one motherboards at the surface-mount component level (BGA, QFN, SOD and SOT) using specialized equipment. Diagnosed faults and delivered fixes for commercial and enterprise warranty products, and handled quality control, inspection and testing of new electronic devices and the return of working units to the field.

avatecsys.summary: Head of Technology at Grupo Avatecsys S.A., designing and planning projects that deliver solutions built on automated or remotely controlled electronic devices for production, security, disaster prevention and civil protection, which resulted in patent MX311249B for the Integrated Seismic Early Warning System. Other responsibilities included team management, voice and data network administration, technical support, staff training, customer service and electronic device repair.

utfv.description: I learned to apply specialized technologies (robots, CNC lathes, programmable logic controllers, industrial computers) to implement partial or full automation solutions in manufacturing systems, ensuring their safe operation and the efficiency of their industrial processes.

cecytem.description: I learned to propose information-system and database solutions, adopt new technology developments in administrative areas and evaluate their implementation within the organization, supporting executive decision-making and the productive and social development of the country.
